regions.name: Lantern Meadow
regions.newMechanic: Touch, listen, and bring the garden to life.

scenes.name: Fox Hollow
scenes.spokenDescription: A welcoming meadow and lantern orchard, connected by broad paths. Ember is your fox companion. Together you help the old oak, bring light to a garden, and make a home for fireflies with Luma the owl.

entities.name: your companion
entities.description: Ember, the friendly fox, follows the explorer and shares the adventure.

entities.name: old oak
entities.description: The old oak is a welcoming tree with a little door and golden windows. Its song reveals the glowing acorn.

lockedExplanation.base: The acorn is still asleep, high in the branches. If we sing the oak's waking song, it will hand it down to us.

byCompanion.ember: The acorn is snoozing up in the branches — even my nose can't reach that high! Let's sing the oak's waking song. Yip!
byCompanion.petal: The acorn is dreaming up in the branches... I flew past it! Sing the oak's waking song and it will drift down to us.
byCompanion.clover: Shh... the acorn is sleeping up in the branches. If we sing the waking song very nicely, the oak will hand it down.

entities.name: river bell
entities.description: The brass bell sings beside the safe stone bridge.

entities.name: lantern flower
entities.description: A tall flower with a glowing lantern at its heart.

entities.name: garden star
entities.lockedExplanation: This little light is still sleeping. Let us finish the garden song first.

entities.name: Orchard arch
entities.description: A broad silver-wood arch with warm lanterns leads to the blue-leaved orchard.
entities.lockedExplanation: The orchard is resting. Let us finish our current little adventure first.

entities.name: Luma the owl
entities.description: Luma is a gentle owl who tends the orchard and makes little homes for fireflies. She wears a blue scarf and carries a tiny lantern.
entities.lockedExplanation: The orchard is resting. Let us finish our current little adventure first.

entities.name: Moon harp
entities.description: A tall brass harp with seven luminous strings. Its gentle song wakes the orchard fireflies.
entities.lockedExplanation: The orchard is resting. Let us finish our current little adventure first.

entities.name: Moon seed
entities.description: A large honey-gold seed with silver wings. It holds the light of the orchard song.
entities.lockedExplanation: The orchard is resting. Let us finish our current little adventure first.

entities.name: Lantern nest
entities.description: A stone pedestal with a woven silver nest. Plant the moon seed here to make a resting place for the fireflies.
entities.lockedExplanation: The orchard is resting. Let us finish our current little adventure first.

spokenSummary.base: The old oak lost its glowing acorn. We promised to wake the oak with its favorite song and bring the acorn home.

byCompanion.ember: Yip! The old oak lost its glowing acorn. We promised to sing the oak awake and sniff that acorn home!
byCompanion.petal: The old oak is dreaming about its lost glowing acorn... we promised to wake it gently with its favorite song.
byCompanion.clover: The old oak misses its glowing acorn. We promised — very quietly — to sing it awake and bring the acorn home.

steps.intro: Ember is waiting just ahead. Walk over together.

celebration.base: You found your friend! This is the start of something wonderful.

byCompanion.ember: Yip yip! You found me! This is the start of something wonderful!
byCompanion.petal: Ooh, there you are! Like two clouds finding each other.
byCompanion.clover: Oh my... you found me. I'm so glad it's you.

hintLadder: Look for your orange fox friend.
Ember is just ahead.
Use the compass and I will guide us to Ember.

steps.intro: Say hello to your new friend!
steps.celebration: A friendship like this only comes along once in a forest.
hintLadder: Your friend is waiting to chat.
Tap your friend to say hello.
Tap the glowing friend right in front of you to start talking.

steps.intro: The oak has a teal door and warm golden windows. Let us follow its gentle bell.
steps.celebration: You found the old oak! Its branches stretch over you like a roof of stars.
hintLadder: Look for the enormous oak.
Follow the broad pale path toward the golden windows.
Use the compass and I will guide us to the oak.

intro.base: The oak is sleeping. Listen to its waking song, then sing it back!

byCompanion.ember: The oak snores louder than me! Listen to its waking song, then sing it back — yip!
byCompanion.petal: Shh... the oak is dreaming. Listen to its waking song, then sing it back softly.
byCompanion.clover: The oak is deep asleep. Listen very carefully to its song, then we'll sing it back together.

steps.celebration: The old oak stretches its branches awake! Leaves shiver with happiness all around you.
hintLadder: Listen to the notes first, then copy them.
The song climbs from low to high, one note at a time.
Tap the notes in order, low to high, just like the oak sang them. Take your time — the oak loves to listen.

steps.intro: The oak hands down its glowing acorn — it chimes like a tiny bell. Go collect it!

celebration.base: You did it! The glowing acorn is safe, and the whole forest hums a thank-you.

byCompanion.ember: YIP YIP YIP! The glowing acorn is ours — I mean, the oak's! The whole forest is cheering for you!
byCompanion.petal: Ooh... the acorn glows like a baby star. The whole forest hums a thank-you, one wingbeat at a time.
byCompanion.clover: You did it... you really did it. Can you hear the whole forest humming thank-you? That's for you.

hintLadder: Follow the tiny chime.
The chiming acorn is very close to the oak's roots.
The acorn is right beside the oak, one step away. Follow the silver chime.

quests.title: The Sleeping Lantern Garden
quests.spokenSummary: Across the river, the lantern flowers are sleeping. We can carry the oak’s song to them.

steps.intro: A brass bell waits beside the stone bridge. Let us visit it.
steps.celebration: Here is the river bell. The stream is listening.
hintLadder: A brass bell waits beside the stone bridge. Let us visit it.
Tap the landmark to walk closer together.
Use the compass. I will guide us, and you can stop any time.

steps.intro: Tap the river bell and play its three warm notes.
steps.celebration: The bell sings across the water. Let us follow its song!
hintLadder: Tap the river bell and play its three warm notes.
Tap the landmark to walk closer together.
Use the compass. I will guide us, and you can stop any time.

steps.intro: Cross the stone bridge to the enormous sunflower arch.
steps.celebration: We crossed together! Look at these lovely lantern flowers.
hintLadder: Cross the stone bridge to the enormous sunflower arch.
Tap the landmark to walk closer together.
Use the compass. I will guide us, and you can stop any time.

steps.intro: The tallest lantern flower is waiting in the round garden.
steps.celebration: A sleeping garden, and a little song to wake it.
hintLadder: The tallest lantern flower is waiting in the round garden.
Tap the landmark to walk closer together.
Use the compass. I will guide us, and you can stop any time.

steps.intro: Tap the tall flower. Let us give the garden its song.
steps.celebration: The lantern garden is awake! Every petal holds a little light.
hintLadder: Tap the tall flower. Let us give the garden its song.
Tap the landmark to walk closer together.
Use the compass. I will guide us, and you can stop any time.

steps.intro: A golden star has appeared at the flower’s feet. Let us take it home.
steps.celebration: A garden star! There is enough light to share with the oak.
hintLadder: A golden star has appeared at the flower’s feet. Let us take it home.
Tap the landmark to walk closer together.
Use the compass. I will guide us, and you can stop any time.

quests.title: A Light to Bring Home
quests.spokenSummary: Bring the garden star back to the old oak and light a path for everyone.

steps.intro: Let us return across the bridge to the old oak.
steps.celebration: Home again. The oak is glad to see us.
hintLadder: Let us return across the bridge to the old oak.
Tap the landmark to walk closer together.
Use the compass. I will guide us, and you can stop any time.

steps.intro: Tap the oak and choose how to share our new light.
steps.celebration: The meadow lanterns glow. A little light, a friend beside you, and a whole meadow to explore.
hintLadder: Tap the oak and choose how to share our new light.
Tap the landmark to walk closer together.
Use the compass. I will guide us, and you can stop any time.

quests.title: Luma's Lantern Orchard
quests.spokenSummary: Help Luma wake the fireflies with the moon harp, then plant a moon seed in their lantern nest.

steps.intro: Luma has left her lanterns on for us. Let us visit the silver arch.
hintLadder: Luma has left her lanterns on for us. Let us visit the silver arch.
Tap the compass and Ember will guide us. We can stop whenever we like.

steps.intro: There is Luma the owl. Let us meet her.
hintLadder: There is Luma the owl. Let us meet her.
Tap the compass and Ember will guide us. We can stop whenever we like.

steps.intro: Tap Luma to hear about her fireflies.
steps.celebration: Luma is happy to have our help.
hintLadder: Tap Luma to hear about her fireflies.
Tap the compass and Ember will guide us. We can stop whenever we like.

steps.intro: Let us find the moon harp. Its warm strings are waiting.
steps.celebration: The moon harp is right here.
hintLadder: Let us find the moon harp. Its warm strings are waiting.
Tap the compass and Ember will guide us. We can stop whenever we like.

steps.intro: Tap the harp and play its gentle song.
steps.celebration: Little fireflies are waking in the orchard!
hintLadder: Tap the harp and play its gentle song.
Tap the compass and Ember will guide us. We can stop whenever we like.

steps.intro: A golden moon seed has appeared. Let us pick it up.
hintLadder: A golden moon seed has appeared. Let us pick it up.
Tap the compass and Ember will guide us. We can stop whenever we like.

steps.intro: The seed needs a soft home. Let us visit the lantern nest.
steps.celebration: This looks like a lovely home for a little light.
hintLadder: The seed needs a soft home. Let us visit the lantern nest.
Tap the compass and Ember will guide us. We can stop whenever we like.

steps.intro: Tap the nest to plant our moon seed.
steps.celebration: The fireflies have a home! Luma and Ember are celebrating with you.
hintLadder: Tap the nest to plant our moon seed.
Tap the compass and Ember will guide us. We can stop whenever we like.

line.base: There you are! I've been waiting for you. The old oak needs our help — are you ready for an adventure?

byCompanion.ember: There you are! Yip! I smelled you coming from across the hollow — you smell like adventure! The old oak needs our help. Ready?
byCompanion.petal: Ooh, there you are... I watched you walk in from way up high. The old oak needs our help. Shall we have an adventure, you and I?
byCompanion.clover: Oh! There you are... I heard your footsteps from across the hollow. The old oak needs our help. Will you come with me?

line.base: That's the spirit! Stay close to me and follow the sounds — the forest will show us the way.

byCompanion.ember: YIP! That's the spirit! Stick with me, brave one — foxes first, adventure always!
byCompanion.petal: Ooh, how wonderful! Then let's drift toward the old oak — one wingbeat at a time.
byCompanion.clover: Really? You're so brave... okay! I'll stay right beside you the whole way.

line.base: That's okay — being careful is a kind of brave too. We'll go slowly, and I'll stay right beside you.

byCompanion.ember: Hey, that's okay! Even foxes get whisker-wobbles. We'll go slow, and I'll be your nose AND your courage. Yip.
byCompanion.petal: That's alright, little cloud... nervous wings still fly. We'll go gently, you and I.
byCompanion.clover: Me too, actually... but quiet things are brave too. We'll be nervous together — and that's almost the same as brave.

dialogues.speaker: Ember
dialogues.line: Our garden star can light the way for someone else. Where shall we share its light?

dialogues.speaker: luma
dialogues.line: Hello, little explorers. I am Luma. My fireflies need a gentle song and a place to rest. Would you help me make their lantern home?

choices.memoryValue: Helped Luma make a firefly home

dialogues.speaker: luma
dialogues.line: They carry tiny lights through my orchard. The moon harp wakes them, and a moon seed grows a warm place for them to sleep. There is no hurry.

choices.text: Let us find the moon harp.
choices.memoryValue: Learned about Luma and her fireflies

dialogues.speaker: ember
dialogues.line: Our seed fits perfectly in this soft little nest. What shall we wish for its new firefly family?
